# An existing price, given by its guid, with another source and another type.
#
# What this fixture produces: the price keeps its commodity, currency, time and
# value, and holds `user:price-editor` and `bid` in place of what it had. The
# test fills in the guid of the price it exported.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_prices_source_and_type_are_kept_as_gnucash_wrote_them.py.
price
	guid: "{guid}"

	type: "bid"
